title: Special Topics in Introduction Theatre and Performance; Theatrical Sewing: Alterations & Clothing Repair
description: Open to all UMD students. Theatrical sewing is an introductory class that offers instruction on both hand and machine sewing. Students will learn how to assess, fit, and alter/repair garments using various sewing techniques. This course is opened to all experience levels. For more details email ddrigger@umd.edu.
